Noah Reed: Quick follow-up from the KV-cache PM: we have three remediation actions — backoff tuning, alert dedupe/thresholds, and a pre-batch warmup. Need owners + Jira.
Emi Takahashi: I'll own backoff tuning. Will open a ticket and draft a safe rollout plan. ETA Fri.
Diego Alvarez: I'll take alerts and dedupe logic. Plan is two-tier alerts (warn/crit) and a 5m dedupe window.
Sonia Park: I'll do the warmup script and update runbook /runbooks/kv-warmup.md. Will add handoff steps for oncall.
Noah Reed: Please include the troubleshooting commands we used in the incident in the tickets. Example: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=redwood-runtime | grep kv` and `rundump --since 2h`.
Emi Takahashi: Ticket created REM-3161 for backoff. Adding RACI: R=Emi, A=Noah, C=eng-runtime, I=oncall.
Diego Alvarez: REM-3162 for alerts created, set P2. Linking graphs and paging thresholds.
Sonia Park: REM-3163 for warmup and runbook. I'll attach the script and smoke checks.
PagerBot: I'll post weekly reminders for open REM tickets and alert if any regressions occur.
Noah Reed: Thanks — owners assigned and tickets open. Can each owner populate acceptance criteria (metrics that must improve) in their REM ticket by EOD Friday? If blockers, escalate to me.
